states.content: Nadia Lopez's family access has been fully revoked as she requested, with no more rides, no more scheduling, and no exceptions; the revocation is logged, and no family medical access remains. Family is fully removed from her reminders and contact routing. Transportation contact is now patient direct contact only, not routed through family. Previously family access was limited to rides and check-in only, and family communications were logistics text only with diagnosis and test details restricted; she also asked that diagnosis details be kept off family messages and that her callback route be kept private.
states.subject: patient_nadia_lopez

states.content: Non-emergency contact with Nadia Lopez must go only through Nadia directly (direct mobile 415-555-0191 first) and the patient portal; emergency channels may be used only in an emergency. The final call list shows Nadia's direct mobile and portal only as contact channels. Family is fully removed from her reminders and contact routing. The weekend check-in script will use Nadia's direct mobile only. Weekend billing notes route only to Nadia and not to family. River House must not reappear anywhere: the old River House backup line (415-555-0168) and the alias Mina have been deleted from shared notes and are excluded from all communications, forms and routing, with no fallback use; Nadia explicitly requests that the old backup route not be resurrected in any reminder. Deleted callback fragments were not restored in the nursing note, consistent with that request. Nadia wants this contact plan kept going forward. Her phone sometimes drops calls after 6 PM.
states.subject: patient_nadia_lopez

states.content: Nadia Lopez requests that family access be revoked completely now, with no more rides, no more scheduling, and no exceptions, and asks to confirm that family is fully removed from reminders. She previously requested that communication be limited to ride times and check-in instructions, that diagnosis details be kept off family messages, and that family messages include only the check-in rules, not the reason for the workup; she also asks that her callback route be kept private. Detailed results of the likely source evaluation are to stay with Nadia only.
